title: Websites & Apps
tagline: Scaffold modern web apps, accessible landing pages, and responsive components

cases.title: High-Converting Dark-Mode Landing Page
cases.description: Generate a modern Tailwind CSS + React landing page with hero, social proof, feature grid, and pricing.
cases.prompt: Generate a modern dark-mode landing page in React and Tailwind CSS featuring a hero banner, animated feature cards, and clean typography.

cases.title: Analytics Dashboard with Real-Time Charts
cases.description: Construct an interactive dashboard layout with metric cards, latency gauges, and Recharts integration.
cases.prompt: Build a responsive analytics dashboard in React with metric summary tiles, token throughput chart, and dark mode design tokens.
cases.sample_output: Dashboard component created with 4 KPI cards (Tokens/sec, Cost saved, Cache hit rate, Active nodes) and responsive chart containers.

cases.title: Accessible WCAG 2.1 Component Library
cases.description: Create accessible UI components (Modal, Dropdown, Tabs) with ARIA roles and keyboard traps.
cases.prompt: Implement an accessible Modal dialog in React with focus-trapping, Esc keyboard listener, and proper ARIA dialog attributes.
cases.sample_output: Accessible Modal implemented: handles Escape key, restores activeElement focus upon close, role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'.

cases.title: Full-Stack Local SQLite + FastAPI Interface
cases.description: Scaffold a complete local CRUD interface connecting React frontend to Python FastAPI endpoints.
cases.prompt: Scaffold a full-stack CRUD view for managing background tasks, featuring optimistic UI updates and FastAPI backend routes.
cases.sample_output: Full-stack module scaffolded: FastAPI router with Pydantic validation and React custom hook with optimistic UI cache.
